roles.permissionGuide:
How permissions work:

• Permission changes reach users when the page is reloaded or within 5 minutes.

• A section appears in the menu when it has the “View page” permission.

• Add, edit, and delete actions are controlled by their separate section permissions.

• Users normally see data only for their assigned branches.

• Select the (!) icon next to a section for details about its permissions.

The checkbox at the start of a row decides whether that price is imported. “From” is the day the price takes effect (DD.MM), set separately for each row.
